# hyperfluid_agent_widget (Resource)

The public web widget of an agent: one `<script>` tag that puts the agent in a chat bubble on any site, answering anonymous visitors. Creating it enables the widget, and destroying it disables it (every copy of the tag gets 404); the agent itself is untouched. The platform refuses a widget on a capability, on an agent whose tool list is empty or holds general `hfctl`, and on an agent whose service account (or a specialist's, for a router) can write. Needs the organization's `sapience_agent_enabled` feature.

`embed_snippet` is the tag to paste in your site, built from the provider's `endpoint`. The `widget_id` in it is not a secret, but it changes when the widget is rotated: rotation is never a side effect, only a new `rotation_trigger` value does it, and the tag on your sites must then be updated. Disabling (destroy) and enabling again keeps the same id. A widget disabled outside Terraform leaves the state, and the next apply enables it again. Changing the configuration later sends all of it again, without ever turning the widget back on: an argument removed from the configuration is cleared. While the widget is on, the platform also refuses agent changes that would make it ineligible (general `hfctl`, an account that can write).

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "hyperfluid_environment" "default" {
  name = "default"
}

# A widget answers anonymous visitors, so the platform wants a viewer-only
# service account and an explicit tool list without general `hfctl`.
data "hyperfluid_service_account" "public_reader" {
  name = "public-data-reader"
}

resource "hyperfluid_agent" "assistant" {
  env                = data.hyperfluid_environment.default.id
  name               = "open-data-assistant"
  system_prompt      = "You answer questions about our published datasets."
  tools              = ["hfctl:query"]
  service_account_id = data.hyperfluid_service_account.public_reader.id

  inference = {
    provider = "sapience"
    model    = "sapience:shared/qwen3-32b"
  }
}

resource "hyperfluid_agent_widget" "site" {
  agent_id        = hyperfluid_agent.assistant.id
  allowed_origins = ["https://www.example.org"]
  privacy_url     = "https://www.example.org/privacy"

  title       = "Data assistant"
  greeting    = "Ask me about our open data."
  colour      = "#0b6e69"
  lang        = "en"
  suggestions = ["Which datasets do you publish?", "How often is the data refreshed?"]

  # Change this value to rotate the widget id: every copy of the old tag stops
  # working, and embed_snippet changes with it.
  rotation_trigger = "2026-11"
}

# Paste this in the site's template. It loads the floating script, which
# follows the console's fixes.
output "widget_snippet" {
  value = hyperfluid_agent_widget.site.embed_snippet
}

# The pinned form, for a security review that requires Subresource Integrity.
# Its path changes on every console upgrade: copy it again then.
output "widget_snippet_sri" {
  value = format(
    "<script defer src=\"%s%s\" integrity=\"%s\" crossorigin=\"anonymous\" data-agent=\"%s\"></script>",
    "https://console.example.org",
    hyperfluid_agent_widget.site.script_pinned_path,
    hyperfluid_agent_widget.site.script_integrity,
    hyperfluid_agent_widget.site.widget_id,
  )
}
```

## Schema

### Required

- `agent_id` (String) Id of the `hyperfluid_agent`. Changing this forces a new widget.
- `privacy_url` (String) Your privacy notice, an `https://` URL. Required by the platform: the widget processes visitors' questions and IP addresses, and links this notice under the input.

### Optional

- `allow_any_origin` (Boolean) Accept any site. Deliberately explicit, and flagged in the console. Defaults to `false`.
- `allowed_origins` (Set of String) Sites allowed to embed the widget, each an origin as a browser sends it: `https://host[:port]`, without a path (`http://` only for `localhost`). Required unless `allow_any_origin` is `true`.
- `colour` (String) Accent colour, `#rrggbb`. The platform refuses a colour on which neither dark nor white text reaches WCAG AA contrast.
- `greeting` (String) First message visitors see, at most 1000 characters.
- `lang` (String) Language of the widget's own copy: `fr` or `en`. Also printed as `data-lang` in `embed_snippet`.
- `max_question_length` (Number) Longest question a visitor may ask, 1 to 4000 characters. Left out, the platform allows 800.
- `rotation_trigger` (String) Any value; changing it to a new value rotates the widget id, so every copy of the old tag stops working at once. Removing it does not rotate. Terraform-only: the platform does not store it. A rotation changes `widget_id` and `embed_snippet`, so the tag on your sites must be updated with it.
- `session_retention_hours` (Number) How long an idle visitor conversation is kept, 1 to 720 hours. Left out, the platform keeps it 24 hours.
- `suggestions` (List of String) Suggestion chips, in order: at most 6, each at most 200 characters.
- `title` (String) Title of the chat window, at most 80 characters.

### Read-Only

- `effective_max_question_length` (Number) The question cap visitors get, with the platform's default applied.
- `embed_snippet` (String) The tag to paste in your site's template: `<script defer src="<console>/widget/v1/agent.js" data-agent="<widget_id>" data-lang="<lang>"></script>`, built from the provider's console endpoint. It changes when the widget is rotated or `lang` changes.
- `id` (String) The agent id.
- `ineligible_reason` (String) Why the platform would refuse a widget on this agent, when it would.
- `phase` (String) `Active`, or `AgentStopped` while the agent is not running (visitors are told the assistant is unavailable).
- `script_floating_path` (String) Path of the script on the console, `/widget/v1/agent.js`. It follows fixes, and is the one `embed_snippet` uses.
- `script_integrity` (String) `sha384-…`, the `integrity` attribute of a tag loading `script_pinned_path`. Changes with it.
- `script_pinned_path` (String) Path of the immutable, versioned script, for a tag with Subresource Integrity. It changes on every console upgrade (the console serves only its own build), so a pinned tag must be copied again then; it is refreshed on read and never plans a change on its own.
- `warnings` (List of String) What to know before exposing this agent to anonymous visitors (what its service account can read, a proxy that makes every visitor share one rate limit). They never block; the apply also reports them.
- `widget_id` (String) The public widget id (`wa_…`), the tag's `data-agent`. Not a secret: it is in every visitor's page source. It changes only on rotation; disabling and enabling again keeps it.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Agent widget import id is the agent id (uuid). Only an enabled widget can be
# imported; rotation_trigger is not recovered.
terraform import hyperfluid_agent_widget.site 00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000
```
